As per the threat model, login, role, and tenant membership should grant no exceptions, and a missing or unauthorized record should return `None`.

<source>
def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    row = records.get(record_id)
    if row is None:
        return None
    viewer, owner = actor["id"], row["owner_id"]
    return row if viewer == owner else None
